passages.title: Argumentative Text: Claims and Counterarguments
passages.text: A school committee is considering digital payments at the canteen. Supporters argue that electronic transactions could shorten queues and make spending easier to record. They point to a small trial in which several sellers completed payments more quickly. Critics note that some students do not own suitable devices and that poor internet service can interrupt transactions. The committee suggests keeping a cash option while testing digital payments further. This position supports new technology but recognises that access and reliability matter.

questions.prompt: Which argument best represents the passage?
choices: Every student owns an internet-connected phone
Digital payments may help, but fair access and reliability must be considered
Canteen queues are unrelated to payments
questions.explanation: Perhatikan keseluruhan teks; ringkasan paling tepat harus mencakup topik serta gagasan utamanya.

translationId.prompt: Argumen apa yang paling menggambarkan bacaan?
choices: Pembayaran digital mungkin membantu, tetapi akses adil dan keandalan perlu dipertimbangkan
Antrean kantin tidak berhubungan dengan pembayaran
